120c7608f0e04afc60f7.en: Ordinal numbers tell us the place in a line.
120c7608f0e04afc60f7.id: Bilangan urutan (ordinal) menunjukkan tempat dalam satu barisan.

12d88721ee349702c144.en: Counting from the left, the cat is 1st and the dog is 2nd.
12d88721ee349702c144.id: Kalau dihitung dari kiri, kucing ada di urutan 1st dan anjing di urutan 2nd.

bcb3d1b5f3e07a241b1c.en: We also say first, second, third and fourth.
bcb3d1b5f3e07a241b1c.id: Kita juga menyebutnya first, second, third, dan fourth.

15946473ba946fbce64e.en: After 4th, most places end in th.
